notes.title: Game update on April 8th
notes.notes:
1. Role reinforcement changed to reward selection

2. Change refresh extraction to infinite extraction

3. The enemy's attack has changed from linear refresh to non-linear refresh

4. Adjust some character attributes and skills

notes.title: 20230329 Update Description
notes.notes:
1. Increase the anger bar, accumulate anger during general attacks, and release skills when full of anger

2. The level is changed from gold purchase to automatic increase as the level increases

3. Modify some skill special effects
